text: Premier Tech Ltd is a private company headquartered in Rivière-du-Loup, Quebec: its own history says it went private in 2007, and Les Affaires describes it as a family company led by president and CEO Jean Bélanger, whose father Bernard Bélanger bought the company in 1978 and chairs its board.
short: Premier Tech is a private Quebec company run by the Bélanger family.

source.name: Les Affaires: 'Un leader mondial ancré dans son coin de pays' (François Normand; Wayback Machine capture of 2024-11-06)
source.quote: Bernard Bélanger, le père de Jean Bélanger, l'a achetée en 1978; il est aujourd'hui président du conseil d'administration de Premier Tech.
source.note: Same article describes Premier Tech as 'l'entreprise familiale' and Jean Bélanger as 'président et chef de la direction'.

additionalSources.name: Premier Tech: 'Discover our journey' (Wayback Machine capture of 2025-09-11)
additionalSources.quote: 2007 – Premier Tech goes private after 20 years as a public company.
